W08

Activity and notification settings

/app/activity
Roles: student, instructor, taScope: requiredPriority: coreLegacy: S13

Show academic events across a selected term and control optional delivery separately. In-app history remains available when email or browser delivery is off.

Entry and return
Global Activity navigationW05 update cardW07 reminder settingsW10 notification preference link
Layout regions
Activity headerTerm, course, event type and unread filters; Older history pagination; settings button
Event listPublished announcements/content, receipt changes and released-feedback availability; Instructor grading/release tasks; TA allocation/deadline events within scope
Settings drawerOptional channel/frequency by event type; class reminder timing; Browser permission status separate from application preference

Keep in-app onlyContinue to browser prompt
Permissions
  • No score in activity previews, email subjects or browser notification text.
  • TA receives allocated grading facts only; never policy/release control events as actions.
  • Hidden content leaves no event or count hint.
Responsive
  • Filters collapse into a labelled panel; chronology remains readable.
  • Settings drawer becomes a scrollable full-screen web dialog.
Accessibility
  • Unread is written text; mark-read controls include item title.
  • Status announcements do not steal focus when new events arrive.
Data
  • Academic event reference/version, term, type, personal read state and source time.
  • Separate application preference and browser capability/permission state.
Acceptance checks (3)
  • Disabling delivery preserves the in-app event history.
  • A held staff score creates no learner score or grading-progress preview.
  • Failed preference save never displays 'saved' or claims a notification was sent.
Notes
  • PROPOSED academic web route template for HTML-first handoff; legacy IDs show lineage, not replacement or changed acceptance.
